description: Text on hover and focus, and the only right answer for naming an icon-only control. Popover is a card on click, Dropdown is a menu. Copy: names the control, it does not explain it. If the words are needed to decide, they belong on the page — a tooltip is unreachable on a touch screen and gone on the next keystroke.

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay before the tooltip appears (ms). Default 300.

props.name: enabled
props.description: When false, renders children untouched. Default true.

example:
<Row gap={3} align="center">
  <Tooltip content="Duplicate">
    <IconButton icon="content_copy" aria-label="Duplicate" onClick={() => undefined} />
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip content="Archive" placement="bottom">
    <IconButton icon="folder" aria-label="Archive" onClick={() => undefined} />
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip content="Saves as you type" placement="end">
    <Button variant="secondary">Autosave</Button>
  </Tooltip>
</Row>
